Sorry you've been left waiting, that shouldn't happen. I'm here now and can pick it up.

What's your order number, and what did you need help with? If you don't have the number handy, the email or phone number you ordered with works too.

You're right that the BS-2 came in under the advertised 10 TH/s. The team is compensating everyone who bought one, so let me check where yours stands.

What's your order number? Send it with one detail from the order, like the name it ships to or the postcode. No order number? The email or phone you ordered with works too.

Sorry, that's frustrating, and it's not how it should have gone. Yesterday's chat isn't in front of me right now. Once I have your order up, I can see what's been done on your compensation and push it forward.

I can't send the refund or the code myself, only the team can. What's different now is that your case is marked as a repeat, with no reply yesterday, so it won't get missed again. Usually someone answers within one business day.

One small thing worth checking: any reply from us may go to (email hidden), so have a look in spam or promotions too.
